options.B: Primarily scientific understanding with some mystery

items.text: Person A follows all scientifically-validated wellness practices but feels empty. Person B neglects physical health but has deep spiritual peace. Who is better off?

options.A: Person A—empirically-based wellness is real well-being
options.B: Person A probably, though B's peace has some value
options.C: Impossible to judge—different dimensions of well-being
options.D: Person B probably—spiritual peace is deeper
options.E: Person B—spiritual well-being is more fundamental

items.text: Can science fully explain human flourishing?

options.A: Yes—flourishing is reducible to brain states and life circumstances
